name: Current-limiting circuit breaker
summary: A current-limiting breaker reduces the fault-current peak and energy passed to downstream equipment within its documented operating range.
description: A current-limiting breaker reduces the fault-current peak and energy passed to downstream equipment within its documented operating range. The drawing tag identifies the characteristic, while coordination data belongs in the design documentation.
readingNotes: Use manufacturer let-through curves for the applicable prospective fault level.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Current limitation is a fault-interruption characteristic, not a continuously regulated load-current function.
